answer:
FINAL: TOI-789 b, TOI-789 d, and TOI-789 c are the current first three super-Earths in NASA’s Exoplanet Catalog (checked October 28, 2026).

Criterion: “Top” means the first three entries in NASA’s continuously updated catalog after selecting only Planet Type → Super Earth, preserving the site’s displayed order. The catalog presents a list of confirmed planets, rather than a ranking of scientific merit or habitability.

https://science.nasa.gov/exoplanet-catalog/toi-789-b/

2. TOI-789 d — The most massive of these three, at 6.6 Earth masses and 1.4 Earth radii. It orbits an M-type star every 13 days at 0.077 AU. Detected through transits; discovery announced in 2026.
https://science.nasa.gov/exoplanet-catalog/toi-789-d/

3. TOI-789 c — A smaller super-Earth with 3 Earth masses and 1.15 Earth radii. It circles an M-type star every 8 days at 0.056 AU. Detected through transits; discovery announced in 2026.
https://science.nasa.gov/exoplanet-catalog/toi-789-c/
